generic.prompt: Follow the assignment. For workflow:agent issue or comment requests, use issue-execute.

task-orchestrate.description: Coordinate isolated repository tasks through independent reviews and PR delivery.
task-orchestrate.prompt: Load task-orchestrate before starting. Delegate each task role to its named agent in a fresh context, without resuming a prior session.

task-plan.description: Plan scope and authoritative specifications before independent review.
task-plan.prompt: Load task-plan and follow its compact role contract.

task-review-plan.description: Independently review the assigned plan and specification commit.
task-review-plan.prompt: Load task-review-plan and follow its compact role contract.

task-implement.description: Implement and verify the independently accepted plan.
task-implement.prompt: Load task-implement and follow its compact role contract.

task-review-implementation.description: Independently review the assigned implementation commit.
task-review-implementation.prompt: Load task-review-implementation and follow its compact role contract.

task-document.description: Document verified behavior after implementation review.
task-document.prompt: Load task-document and follow its compact role contract.

task-review-documentation.description: Independently review the assigned documentation commit or no-change decision.
task-review-documentation.prompt: Load task-review-documentation and follow its compact role contract.
